core.nudge.helpWeb: A short note at the top of the screen when you finish a goal. Notifications and the evening reminder are in the Android app.
core.nudge.setRisk: Evening reminder if the flame is not lit
core.nudge.usualAt: Comes at {at}, a little after you usually light your flame, and only if it is still unlit.
core.nudge.usualLearning: Comes at {at} for now. After a few days it moves to a little after the time you usually read.
core.nudge.riskBodyUsual: You usually read by now. One page or a few minutes of listening keeps it lit.
core.nudge.calm: At most two notes a day, none between 22:00 and 06:00 (the evening reminder comes at the time you chose).
core.nudge.goalBody: Your flame is lit for today. Your Light is waiting on Me.
core.nudge.goalBodyN: Day {n} of your flame. Your Light is waiting on Me.
core.nudge.allBody: May Allah accept it from you. Claim your Light on Me.
core.nudge.freezeBody: A missed day is covered. A new freeze comes on Saturday.
core.nudge.riskBody: One page, a few minutes of listening or your dhikr keeps it lit.
core.nudge.askTitle: A note when you finish a goal?
core.nudge.askBody: We can tell you when a goal is done while you listen, and remind you in the evening if your flame is not lit yet. At most two a day; change it any time in Settings.
core.mo.title: Read without internet
core.mo.offer: Download the whole mushaf once ({size} MB) so every page opens without internet. It carries on while the app is open and picks up where it left off.
core.mo.help: Pages you have opened already work offline. Download all 604 pages once ({size} MB) to read any page without internet.
core.mo.waiting: Downloading continues when you are online with the app open.
core.mo.done: The whole mushaf is on this device: every page opens without internet.
core.sel.oneSurah: A reel uses ayat from one surah
